discussion.body: Concept art pass for the three main villains (FF8 proportions, painted key art). Vortan: Constium Forge-King, generous court face, Cannon brooch, industrial gold on black. Velith: Bengenia Archon, veil-crown, pale mist vestments; smotherer not Nyxara. Nyxara the Hollow Flame: fissure-born, cracked gold-and-ember form, no human face. Bytes live in project artifacts/Asteria-Concept/. Picture POST to Tracker site skipped: TRACKER_ORIGIN not in vault. Do not put image bytes on GitHub.
